title: How the Liquor Industry Makes Billions From a $3 Bottle

researchBrief.angle: How the Liquor Industry Makes Billions From a Single $3 Bottle
hookIdeas: A $3 bottle of spirits? Sounds too good to be true! But what if I told you that's the cost of producing just one bottle of liquor?
From grain to glass, the liquor industry's secret to making billions lies in the 'three-tier system'. Let's crack it open!
What happens when a $25 bottle of liquor becomes $240 at the bar? It's a math problem that'll make your head spin – but it's true!
talkingPoints: The cost of producing a standard bottle of spirits is barely $3, thanks to economies of scale and efficient production processes.
However, the three-tier distribution system adds a whopping 30-50% markup at each stage, before government excise taxes kick in.
Bars and clubs turn the same $25 bottle into $240 by selling 16 individual pours at $15 each, making it a lucrative business for nightlife establishments.
Branding, artificial scarcity, and the nightlife experience all contribute to the liquor industry's remarkable profitability, making it one of the highest-margin businesses on earth.
